items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: He was the first great bass player that I worked with.

ctx.x: He never would leave Cincinnati, but one of the greatest tuba players that I have ever known. He played an E-flat upright tuba but, oh, my goodness, he could
play solos and everything. But nobody could get him out of Cincinnati. He was the first great bass player that I worked with.
